additional_probe: Acknowledge the first looping wake, re-arm the production watcher, and verify the next durable wake reports escalation 2 (watcher-loop-output.txt).
scope: Watcher subprocesses and daemon handlers used fixture terminal/gate inputs. These are behavioral regression checks, not live end-to-end validation.
live_blocker: no-mistakes axi status: repo not initialized. Test phase cannot init, start, or control a gate; it also cannot inspect another checkout or the bare gate repository.
remedy: Arrange a pre-provisioned, authorized disposable parked gate and harness/supervisor lab inside the permitted boundary, then re-run live validation. Herdr lifecycle must use bin/fm-herdr-lab.sh with a named fm-lab-* session.
